challenges.name: Stone Wall
challenges.desc: Fly the Pebblekin cruiser and let your rock-solid crew soak up the punishment. Reach sector 4.

challenges.name: Slug Life
challenges.desc: The Sloog ship with one basic laser. Hack, mind control and outthink every enemy to sector 4.

challenges.name: Glass Gun
challenges.desc: A beam, a heavy laser and an ion blaster on a ship that cracks if you look at it. Reach sector 5.

challenges.name: Clown Car
challenges.desc: Eight crew of every race, no room to breathe. Keep them all alive to sector 4.

challenges.name: Rich Kid
challenges.desc: Start with 300 scrap, but wrecks pay almost nothing. Shop smart at the first stores and coast to sector 5.

challenges.name: Eye of the Storm
challenges.desc: The Voltan ship with a thin hull and a quick fleet behind you. Reach sector 6.

challenges.name: Naked Hull
challenges.desc: Shield layers take three times as long to come back. Dodge with big engines and kill fast. Reach sector 4.

challenges.name: The Long Way Round
challenges.desc: A nine-sector map flown in the Bortex. Reach sector 7.
